verdict.rationale: Vue is well known for CDN/script-tag usage without a build step, and community evidence directly confirms it: 'download vue(.min).js and you are ready to go. No packagemanager, bundler and what not needed' and Vue is praised as the framework most easily added incrementally into existing pages without tooling.
